setupDiscover.title: What is running on your servers
setupDiscover.subtitle: Sites, containers, Node apps and databases. Colour chips are suggested projects, matched by domain and folder name.

lane.unread: {n} source not read | {n} sources not read

details.label: Details
details.dropped: {n} line dropped as invalid | {n} lines dropped as invalid
details.envOne: .env at {path} listed, not readable (its DB name is asked in step 3)
details.envMany: {n} .env files listed, not readable (their DB names are asked in step 3)
details.nothing: No lines dropped, every .env listed can be read

fix.pm2HomeBody: its apps cannot be listed from this login ({login}).
fix.pm2HomeBodyNoLogin: its apps cannot be listed from this login.
fix.pm2HomeAdd: Add a second host in ~/.ssh/config that logs in as {user}, then Read again.
fix.pm2HomeAddAt: Add a second host in ~/.ssh/config that logs in as the owner of that folder, then Read again.

docker_no_permission.name: Docker
docker_no_permission.body: no permission, so containers and compose projects are missing.

docker_stopped.name: Docker
docker_stopped.body: is not running, so containers and compose projects are missing.

pm2_missing.name: pm2
pm2_missing.body: command missing on this login's PATH, so its apps cannot be listed.

nginx_no_permission.name: nginx config
nginx_no_permission.body: not readable, so that site may be missing.

listening.none: Every listener belongs to a find.
listening.note: Kept for step 3. A database port open to the internet is flagged again in the first security scan.

pairs.empty: Pairs show here when names match across hosts
pairs.label: {project}: back end on {be}, front end on {fe}

rail.title: What discover reads
rail.note: Reads config and process lists only. .env files are located, never opened here.

add.title: Something missing?
add.body: Apps run by systemd or cron are not listed. Add one by its folder path.
add.hint: An absolute path on that host.
add.doneDetail: It is listed under Not in a project in step 3.

foot.hint: You can continue now. Late finds join the next step.
foot.hintWait: Continue is ready when the first host has been read.
